headlines.description: Lionel Messi enjoyed a fairy tale farewell as he scored on his last appearance for Argentina in a 3-0 win over Benin in Buenos Aires.
headlines.shortLinkText: Messi scores in farewell as Argentina beat Benin

headlines.description: The United States capped its September/October international window with a scrappy 1-0 win over Canada in St. Paul, Minnesota, on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: USMNT finishes perfect window with feisty win over Canada
